reason: The README describes a DSH plugin that reminds users to save conversations and incrementally backs up session logs in machine-readable or human-readable formats.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 会话日志提供定时保存提醒、增量本地备份、格式选择和备份文件夹管理功能。
summaries.en: Provides DSH session-log reminders, incremental local backups, format selection, and backup-folder management.

capabilities: copies session logs to a user-selected local backup folder
renders session logs as readable text files
persists backup settings and indexes locally
shows scheduled reminder dialogs and exposes same-origin local HTTP routes
